prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head turned about forty-five degrees to her right in a three-quarter view, her eyes still looking straight into the camera, one ear and the turned cheek clearly visible, and from this angle the full projection of her lips from her face is clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the long earrings fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Late 40s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Japanese woman — Japanese poised refined beauty milky ivory-fair complexion with a cool-neutral undertone and natural skin with visible pores, late 40s, long straight silver hair with a side part, extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip, vivid intense crimson-red coloured contact lenses with a radiating sunburst iris pattern, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, looking down along the nose with the chin lifted slightly, lips closed in a faint haughty line, an aloof, haughty expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): the absolute extreme of a 'duck lip' pout: the upper lip lifted high and thrust far forward and upward like the bill of a duck, a plump, broad, glossy ledge that juts dramatically out from her face, the lower lip a full rounded cushion tucked beneath it and pushed forward to meet it, the whole mouth pursed into a bold beak-like pout whose projection from the face is enormous, mirror-glossy deep rose with bright white highlights on both lips, every edge razor-crisp, perfectly symmetrical, so that the lips are by far the dominant feature of her face in this three-quarter view, still reading as a beautiful, believable human face, never smudged past the lip line; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: a strong, angular, square jawline: a wide, clearly defined, sharp-cornered jaw angle just below each ear, a broad flat chin with a slight cleft, hollow sculpted cheeks and very high, razor-sharp cheekbones. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about fifteen in total (not counting the hanging drops), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one straight bar across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; one small bar or ring through each eyebrow, all on the brow bone above the eyes and never on the eyelids; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the lower opening holding a huge dome-shaped bell earring as large as her palm, with rows of tiny gem and pearl drops hanging from its rim, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the upper opening holding a large classic round hoop earring, and above them sit one thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. The face and ear jewelry is real pastel-enamelled gold set with white pearls, pastel gemstones, hearts and stars, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft key light from the front and slightly to the side on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
